insured_share_source: Scene 1: insured staff as a share of the estimated total workforce (low end), all four plants, 2025

line.source: China Labor Watch, Zhengzhou Foxconn report (September 2025), p. 25: a worker says her production line has over 120 workers
line.caveat: One worker's account of her own line, applied to every line here; lines vary. The floor is an illustrative stand-in, not a measured Foxconn layout, and the insured / dispatch mix is the campus-wide average, not counted per line.

dorm.people_source: China Labor Watch, Zhengzhou Foxconn report (September 2025), p. 19: new workers were put in the Fuhang building, six to a room
dorm.size_source: JGJ 36-2016 Code for Design of Dormitory Buildings: a 6-person room with bunk beds, at least 5 m2 of usable floor per person
dorm.caveat: Size is the Chinese design standard for a 6-person bunk room, not a measured Foxconn room; the room image is illustrative.

shift_note: Plants run 3 x 8-hour shifts, so roughly one third of the headcount is on the floor at any moment.
